newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks fall 1.3 mln in week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks fall 1.3 mln in week.

text.p: U.S. inventories of propane fell 1.3 million barrels in the week ending October 25 amid drops in the Midwest and Gulf Coast, according to the Energy Information Administration report on Wednesday.
The unexpected drop put current total stocks at 51 million barrels, about 9.5 percent, or 5.4 million barrels below year-ago levels.
Stocks in the key U.S. Gulf Coast hub fell an estimated 200,000 barrels to 23.2 million, about 13 percent, or 3.5 million barrels below year-ago levels.
USG traders were expecting an 800,000 barrel build.
The Midwest fell one million barrels in the week to 21.0 million, slightly below year-ago levels of 22.6 million, said the EIA.
The draw was expected because of the strong demand in the hub for crop drying.
The East Coast remained unchanged at 5 million barrels, said the EIA.
